items.title: Two refinements inducing the same map give the same map on compatible families

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that two morphisms of coverings which induce the same morphism of the targets give the same map on compatible families (statement lines 2068-2073). The proof is a complete computation: the two morphisms are described by their index maps and component morphisms, with the common map of targets displayed as a commutative diagram (proof lines 2076-2096); and the author compares the two pullback operations on an arbitrary compatible family, using the definition of the compatible families to conclude that the induced maps agree (proof lines 2097-2131). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two pullbacks. The claim is H1/H2: a written-out computation.
